class: A required application-source label is not mapped to an existing saved fact
symptom: After Contact Information progressed, ADP reported Candidate Source is required although the profile already supplies how_did_you_hear.
root_cause: HOW_DID_YOU_HEAR recognized referral-source questions but not the exact labels Candidate Source or Application source, so a supported local answer fell through to model interpretation.
why_tests_missed: Referral-source tests covered matching provider-specific offered labels but not these field-label variants in concept resolution.
fix: Add anchored Candidate Source and Application source wordings to the canonical concept data and reuse the saved profile answer. Source-code questions remain outside the concept.
prevention: Cover question recognition as well as option matching for recurring field families. Expand canonical wording data instead of asking for a fact already in the profile.
